title: Your First Weekend at Bryan College of Health Sciences, Shared as Cards
description: A guide for new Blue Heelers to navigate their first weekend in Lincoln, from essential campus stops to local landmarks near the East and West campuses.

cards.title: Kick Off with Orientation
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Start your journey at the required New Student Orientation to meet faculty and peer educators. Check your student email for the specific room assignment on the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: The mandatory introductory program for all incoming first-year and transfer students at Bryan College of Health Sciences.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Orientation (NSO) is a required program for all new first-year and transfer students to develop relationships and learn about campus resources.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation Policy | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; typically held the week before classes begin.

cards.title: Gear Up at the College Store
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Errands
cards.notes: Visit the third floor of the East Campus to pick up your Bryan apparel, from scrubs to sweatshirts. It is the primary spot for official Blue Healer merchandise.
cards.short_summary: The official on-campus store for Bryan College of Health Sciences apparel and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Healer House is located on the third floor of East Campus and sells college apparel, water bottles, and mugs.
cards.source_title: Healer House - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Located on the 3rd floor of the East Campus building.

cards.entity_name: Bryan College of Health Sciences Library
cards.title: Scope Out Study Spots
cards.subtitle: Friday Late Afternoon
cards.notes: Locate the library on the East Campus to find quiet study areas and research databases. It's a key resource for your upcoming clinical and science coursework.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing specialized health sciences resources and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is located at 1535 S. 52nd St. and provides databases, journals, and historical archives for students.
cards.source_title: Bryan College of Health Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Standard weekday hours are 8:00 am to 4:30 pm during summer; check portal for semester updates.

cards.title: Walk Through the Gardens
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Outdoors
cards.notes: Take a short drive from campus to this historic 1.5-acre terrace. It's a peaceful spot to decompress before the semester's workload begins.
cards.short_summary: A renowned public garden in Lincoln featuring thousands of annuals and themed displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunken Gardens is a public attraction in Lincoln featuring terraced flower beds, ponds, and paved pathways.
cards.source_title: Sunken Gardens – City of Lincoln, NE
cards.access_notes: Open daily to the public; located at 26th and D Streets.

cards.title: Explore the Trail System
cards.subtitle: Saturday Midday Activity
cards.notes: Access the Billy Wolff or Rock Island trails that run through this massive park. It's perfect for a bike ride or a long walk to clear your head.
cards.short_summary: A large municipal park offering extensive trail connections and recreational facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Antelope Park features the Billy Wolff Trail and Rock Island Trail running along Antelope Creek.
cards.source_title: Antelope Park – City of Lincoln, NE
cards.access_notes: Public park access from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Coffee in the Telegraph District
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Break
cards.notes: Head to the Telegraph District location for a local brew. This historic warehouse space is a popular off-campus hangout for Lincoln students.
cards.short_summary: A local coffee roastery and cafe located in a renovated historic district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mill at Telegraph is located at 330 S 21st St and is open until 11pm daily.

cards.title: Find the West Campus Entrance
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Prep
cards.notes: Locate the science labs at the West Campus on 16th Street. You'll likely have classes here for anatomy or simulation labs later in the week.
cards.short_summary: The satellite campus location housing natural science laboratories and simulation centers.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryan College of Health Sciences utilizes space at Bryan Medical Center West for science labs and a simulation center.
cards.access_notes: Located at 2300 S. 16th St; use the main medical center entrance.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Chill
cards.notes: Find the student lounges on the East Campus to meet classmates. These spaces are designed for social interaction and low-key study sessions between labs.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated social and relaxation areas for students within the East Campus facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln campus includes student lounges where current students can be seen interacting in virtual tours.
cards.source_title: Visit Bryan - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: Set Up Your Health Portal
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Admin
cards.notes: Register for ezVisit using your student ID. It provides free virtual care for minor illnesses, ensuring you're prepared if you feel under the weather.
cards.short_summary: A virtual healthcare service provided for free to Bryan College students.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can access ezVisit, a Bryan online virtual care service, at no charge using their student identification number.
cards.source_title: Health and Wellness - Bryan College of Health Sciences

cards.title: Final First-Day Prep
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Routine
cards.notes: Log into the Canvas portal to review your syllabi and first-day assignments. Double-check your schedule for any room changes on the East or West campuses.
cards.short_summary: The final step in preparing for the first day of classes by reviewing digital course materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Current Students page lists Canvas as a primary academic resource for course management.
cards.source_title: Current Students - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the student portal with college credentials.
